name: Abyssal Storm-Watcher
notes: Dark-winged Cognitavi that rides pressure fronts ahead of monsoon squalls. Sailors read its high circling as a storm warning.
journal_prompt: A Cognitavi navigator bird subspecies that specializes in reading weather patterns, guiding wisdom-seekers and ships safely through the Tethys monsoons.
appearance: A Cognitavi: raven-sized, with sleek, iridescent slate-grey plumage, an ivory casque above a sharp hooked beak and amber eyes flecked like stars. The storm-watcher is the dark-winged kind, its wings near-black against a squall sky.
